summary: Full backend + frontend testing for IMS IT Requisition & Asset Management (Step 1). 23/23 pytest tests pass. Frontend flows verified end-to-end via Playwright: login (super admin, exec), role-filtered sidebar (7 groups / 15 items for super_admin; users-roles hidden from executive), Users & Roles listing (9 rows including admin), Departments/Categories/Approvals pages load clean, New Requisition form (product 4-step chain, service 1-step chain, MD threshold auto-adds 5th step at >=50k BDT), submission navigates to Pending, and Approve queue for IT Head shows requisitions with working Approve/Reject buttons and success toast.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is a single 738-line module - consider splitting routers (auth, users, requisitions, org) into modules for maintainability as feature-set grows.
CORS uses env FRONTEND_URL + hardcoded http://localhost:3000; the CORS_ORIGINS env var defined in backend/.env is unused. Recommend consolidating.

Approval chain 'renumber' loop is fine, but status_for_step relies on chain level ordering (dept_head level 1 vs 2) - fragile if chain composition changes. Consider tagging steps with explicit status keys during build_approval_chain to avoid indirect coupling.

next_req_number uses find_one_and_update with return_document=True but does not import ReturnDocument.AFTER - motor returns the pre-update doc by default; the code still works only because upsert creates the doc with seq=1 on first call. Should use ReturnDocument.AFTER for correctness.
auth cookies set with samesite='none'; secure=True which is correct for cross-site preview URL over HTTPS; verified httpOnly present in Set-Cookie header.
No rate limiting / brute-force lockout implemented; /app/auth_testing.md playbook expects 5-fail lockout - flag for future hardening.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend test file at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py covers auth, RBAC, users CRUD, dept/cat CRUD, approval chain composition (product low/high value, service), approve/reject flow, list scopes, dashboard stats, and permission toggles. Run via: pytest /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py -v. Uses REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL from /app/frontend/.env. Note the pydantic EmailStr rejects '.test' TLD - use example.com for synthetic emails.
